title: Workflow action-pin validator accepts a mutable action in a YAML flow sequence
title_de: Workflow-Action-Pin-Validator akzeptiert eine veränderliche Action in einer YAML-Flow-Sequenz
technical_claim: The validator only begins flow-style uses parsing after '{' or a comma in a braced mapping. Valid YAML such as `steps: [uses: actions/setup-python@v6]` therefore contains a mutable external action that is not returned to the full-SHA pin check.
entry_point: PR-controlled .github/workflows YAML reaches the Framework action-pin validator through its workflow check target.
source_to_sink_or_broken_control: The untrusted YAML line reaches flow_mapping_uses_values(); '[' does not start a candidate mapping, so action_references() returns no action and pin_error() is never called.
attacker_prerequisites: Ability to submit a workflow change that reaches the Framework workflow-security gate.
impact: A mutable third-party GitHub Action can bypass the immutable full-commit-SHA enforcement control and execute in GitHub Actions.
expected_behavior: Every valid flow-sequence mapping action reference must either be parsed and required to use a 40-character commit SHA or be rejected as unsupported syntax.
reproduction: Run the focused action-pin test against a temporary workflow containing `steps: [uses: actions/setup-python@v6]`; it must report the mutable action.
legitimate_control: A flow sequence containing the same action pinned to a 40-character commit SHA remains accepted.
bypass_review: Exercise nested flow mappings, quoted values, commas, aliases/tags, expressions, comments, and multiline flow syntax; unsupported forms must fail closed rather than omit uses references.
proposed_remediation: Extend the repository-native flow parser to recognize mapping entries after both '[' and '{' while retaining depth/quote/expression handling; add direct negative and positive regression cases.
validation_plan: Python syntax/import check and git diff --check
parent_impact: None; Parent product and gitlink remain unchanged.
mrts_impact: None; MRTS is not inspected or modified.
residual_risk: The merged Framework master contains the verified source-level correction. The original Codex Cloud finding remains new until a final Cloud scan on this or a later final Framework master can be retrieved and reconciled. The separate master-only SonarQube Cloud Security E gate is tracked by FND-SONAR-0002 and is not causally attributed to this fix.

evidence.command: RTK-wrapped CSV hash validation and static current-master source review
evidence.summary: The export lists Cloud finding 48ddc89c01548191aac6fdc953d4a69b as new/high. Current master still starts uses extraction only at '{' or comma-in-brace, while the unsafe flow-sequence fixture exists.

delivery_evidence.parent_gitlink_disposition: No Parent gitlink was staged, committed, pushed, or proposed. The Parent still records 784977615acfc55567e37b863309abc4a38ac877; the local Framework checkout advanced to the merged master and safe non-forcing restoration is currently blocked because the sandbox denies the Framework index.lock write.
local_validation: The original mutable first-entry flow sequence reproduced before the correction (one focused unittest failed because no pin error was emitted).
The focused action-pin suite passed after the correction (25 tests).
The direct real-workflow action-pin check, Python compilation, Change Record, bilingual-documentation, documentation-link, and diff checks passed.

history.detail: Static source-to-control review confirms the current parser omission. A focused Framework repair is authorized.

The focused Framework repair was in PR #38 at exact head 8907c8ec047df070a579fab926e25b0d94dfbc2e. Local negative/control and focused suite evidence passed; all applicable current-head GitHub checks, including SonarQube Cloud and CodeQL, passed. The PR had no review requests or unresolved threads.

GitHub reports the merge tree equals PR-head tree 4a91bfc7c47efef3b8e44d993e8f4ab1ed5a8cbc; the original negative and legitimate-control tests passed against that identical tree.
